notes.title: Regular Update 10
notes.content:
Reputation from chat articles has been reduced by 5 times, but if the tagged articles are answered, normal reputation will be gained
Clicking on tagged text is likely to give a bonuses

notes.title: Regular Update 9

Wall clocks and vases have been added to the game

The game loading system was divided into pieces while the high performance setting turned off , but I do not know if this will be the definitive solution for those who do not open the game. I would appreciate if the testers write the results.

notes.title: Regular Update 8
notes.content:
With the High Performance setting turned off, the PC Store is now going to the version set specifically for the performance mode
You can now delete the posts in the chat with right click
Ranking in the tournament has been made more difficult, depending on more score
PC checking system has been updated and optimized
FPS drops per hour fixed (needs to be tested)
Custom key names have been changed by languages

Actions are adjusted to write minutes instead of xx hours if it takes less than 1 hour
Some sites translated

notes.title: What are we working on
notes.content:
What will be added with the major update:


 You will be able to own animals and meet their needs
 You will be able to purchase special products for your little friends
 Hard Mode will added to the game, which will be make a longer game experience.
 Selecting a positive and a negative trait during character creation
 The content of mini games will be enriched and made more detailed.
 Mini-game visuals will be changed
 New mails and tasks will be added to the game
 The option to fully end the game and an extra content that you can continue after completing will be added to the game
 Switch page, where you can see your place among major streamers
 Broadcast times will now affect the game. It will be difficult for you to open a broadcast during the broadcast hours of major broadcasters. In addition, the hours you open regularly will be adopted by your followers and you will be able to gain more viewers during these hours


Apart from these, we will continue to add your recommendations with regular updates.
Even if we cannot add all of these features, we will bring many of them with major updates and add others over time. We will share our longer term plans with you later. Good games to everyone.

notes.title: Streamer Daily Update Details
notes.content:
We have made many updates since the game came out. You can read the contents of the updates below.


 At the end of the day you will receive notifications of subscriber gains and how many subscribers decreased
 Freelance jobs now pay 10% extra when reaching maximum money
 All parts now appear during PC build and it says why the part cannot be installed
 Keys of random events are now active after a while
 Warning appears in the ALT-TAB section after using the second monitor
 The monitor does not turn off even if the monitor is broken
 Horrors games are now more diffucult
 Advertising ability also increases youstop revenue by 5%
 Added some sounds for internet purchases
 Items placed in the drawer of the table model 1 fall into error
 RPG mine explosion and gold gain sounds added and gold gain added when Boss defeats


We are making preparations for the next major update. Along with the major update:

Apart from the type of game played, the size of the game will also cause differences in the game. For example, while there are 30 blocks in the least occupied sports game, this number will increase in games that require more systems. In addition, games that require high system will give you extra followers, subscribers, viewers, donations and reputation.
